coverage_policy: Use the fixed 184-task cohort with the six configured systems. Report synthesis coverage separately.
secondary_coverage_metrics: Availability-adjusted totals on all 184, explicitly counting missing programs as unsuccessful, separate from executed-program accuracy.
integration_error_policy: Stop and preserve raw data. Do not score transport or initialization defects as program failures.
candidate_error_policy: Exceptions, non-string outputs and case timeouts are unsuccessful and kept separately.
